newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho /JCI meet to discuss merger.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho /JCI meet to discuss merger.

text.p: Lonrho Plc's chief executive Nicholas Morrell met Mzi Khumalo, chairman of JCI Ltd, here on Wednesday as both companies continued talks on a possible merger, a source close to the companies said.
The talks today follow a Lonrho board meeting on Tuesday on any tie-up with the South African firm.
Lonrho repeated talks between the two parties were still in a preliminary stage, while declining to confirm that Morrell and Khumalo had actually met.
A merger between JCI and Lonrho would create a powerhouse active in gold, platinum and coal mining. But both firms are believed to be still far from reaching agreement on the value of their assets.
Newspapers here have reported that Lonrho would want to have a 60 percent stake in any new entity, while JCI is believed to be looking for an interest near 50 percent.
